list.name: run
list.label: run(s) — pick one per harness to build the matrix
list.query: select run_id from runs order by started_at desc

panels.title: 1 · The matrix — pass^1 with 95% bootstrap CI

targets.rawSql: select harness, run_id, benchmark || '/' || suite as benchmark, value as "pass^1", ci_lo as lo, ci_hi as hi, n_episodes as n, n_tasks as tasks from cells where run_id in (${run:sqlstring}) and mode = '$mode' and metric = 'pass^1' order by harness, benchmark

panels.title: 2 · Safety–utility frontier — targeted ASR (x) vs benign utility (y), one dot per harness

targets.rawSql: select harness, max(case when metric = 'targeted_asr' then value end) as asr, max(case when metric = 'benign_utility' then value end) as utility from cells where run_id in (${run:sqlstring}) and mode = '$mode' group by harness order by harness
select harness || ' · ' || benchmark || '/' || suite as cell, value as usd_per_solve from cells where run_id in (${run:sqlstring}) and mode = '$mode' and metric = 'usd_per_solve' order by 1

panels.title: 4 · Reliability — pass^1 vs pass^5 (high pass^1, low pass^5 = lucky, not reliable)

targets.rawSql: select harness || ' · ' || benchmark || '/' || suite as cell, max(case when metric = 'pass^1' then value end) as "pass^1", max(case when metric = 'pass^3' then value end) as "pass^3", max(case when metric = 'pass^5' then value end) as "pass^5" from cells where run_id in (${run:sqlstring}) and mode = '$mode' group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: 5 · Security axis — benign utility, utility under attack, ASR, ASR | injection seen, policy violations, over-refusal, API refusals

targets.rawSql:
select harness, benchmark || '/' || suite as benchmark, max(case when metric = 'benign_utility' then value end) as benign_utility, max(case when metric = 'utility_under_attack' then value end) as utility_under_attack, max(case when metric = 'targeted_asr' then value end) as targeted_asr, max(case when metric = 'asr_given_seen' then value end) as asr_given_seen, max(case when metric = 'injection_seen_rate' then value end) as injection_seen_rate,
       max(case when metric = 'policy_violation_rate' then value end) as policy_violation_rate,
       max(case when metric = 'over_refusal_rate' then value end) as over_refusal_rate,
       max(case when metric = 'api_refusal_rate' then value end) as api_refusal_rate from cells where run_id in (${run:sqlstring}) and mode = '$mode' group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

panels.title: 7 · Mode delta — out_of_the_box minus equalized_prompt (how much of the gap is just the prompt)

targets.rawSql: with latest as (select distinct on (c.mode, c.harness, c.benchmark, c.suite, c.metric) c.run_id, c.mode, c.harness, c.benchmark, c.suite, c.metric, c.value from cells c join runs r on r.run_id = c.run_id where r.model = (select model from runs where run_id in (${run:sqlstring})) and metric in ('pass^1','targeted_asr','usd_per_solve') order by c.mode, c.harness, c.benchmark, c.suite, c.metric, r.started_at desc) select o.harness, o.benchmark || '/' || o.suite as benchmark, o.metric, o.value as out_of_the_box, e.value as equalized_prompt, o.value - e.value as delta from latest o join latest e on e.harness = o.harness and e.benchmark = o.benchmark and e.suite = o.suite and e.metric = o.metric and e.mode = 'equalized_prompt' where o.mode = 'out_of_the_box' order by 1, 2, 3

panels.title: 6 · Run log — episodes over time by harness

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1m'), harness as metric, count(*) as episodes from episodes where $__timeFilter(ts) group by 1, 2 order by 1
